---
title: "clean ncbi data"
output: github_document
date: "2025-01-20"
---

## objectives
* read in ncbi metadata for H5Nx sequences
* remove vaccine, passaged, cloned
* parse information from genbank titles incl species, location, year
* fill in missing metadata with parsed information
* for species (mix of common and latin), harmonize to common names
* clean country, add continent, region
* find mislabelled segments
* remove rows with incomplete date, country, species, no HA
* make a composite sample ID, remove duplicate segments within sample
* read in ncbi fasta exclude meta removals from seqs
* summary plots of ncbi nuc seqs by species/country/year, length of seqs
* export cleaned unaligned seqs and metadata by segment
* read in protein sequences
* parse protein names, harmonize naming
* match proteins to nucleotide samples
* remove replicate protein seqs within sample
* summary plots of proteins in final data

## Remove modified vaccine strains, passaged, cloned, escape mutants
```{r}
#Vaccine strains
#1. resassorted vaccine strain NIBRG-14
#https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0264410X10000769
rem.vacc<-meta$accession[str_which(meta$genbank_title, "NIBRG-14")]
#not in the recent download where no vaccines specified

#2. other non-modified (?) vaccine strains:
#A/Indonesia/5/2005: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-55546-7
#isolated from human throat swab: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa06093
rem.vacc2<-meta$accession[str_which(meta$genbank_title, "A/Indonesia/5/2005")]
#13 of these though

# A/Vietnam/1203/2004: https://academic.oup.com/jid/article/198/5/635/865131 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3071280/
#isolated from human:  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1212624
rem.vacc3<-meta$accession[str_which(meta$genbank_title, "A/Vietnam/1203/2004")]

#MDCK isolate embryonated chicken egg isolate? are these considered cultured? 
# str_subset(meta$genbank_title,"MDCK")

# https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/DQ659324.1
#these are viruses derived from whooping swan in mongolia
rem.vacc4<-meta$accession[str_which(meta$genbank_title,"St Jude")]
#not present in new data

#Culture, clones, muts
rem.cult<-meta$accession[str_which(meta$genbank_title,"passage|culture")] #cultured sample
rem.clone<-meta$accession[str_which(meta$genbank_title,"clone")] #clones
rem.mutant<-meta$accession[str_which(meta$genbank_title,"mutant")] #monoclonal antibody escape mutant

#all removals
l.rem.all.vacc<-sum(length(rem.vacc), length(rem.vacc2), length(rem.vacc3), length(rem.vacc4)) #29
l.rem.all.vacc 

length(rem.cult); length(rem.clone); length(rem.mutant); 

rem.multi<-unique(c(rem.vacc, rem.vacc2, rem.vacc3, rem.vacc4, 
                    rem.cult, rem.clone, rem.mutant))
length(rem.multi) 

#REMOVE them! 
meta <- meta %>% filter(!accession %in% rem.multi)

cat(paste0("Excluded, vaccines: ",length(c(rem.vacc,rem.vacc2,rem.vacc3,rem.vacc4))),
    paste0("Excluded, cultured: ",length(rem.cult)),
    paste0("Excluded, mutants: ",length(rem.mutant)),
    paste0("Excluded, clones: ",length(rem.clone)),
    paste0("Meta nrow after excl vaccines, cultured, clones, mutants: ",nrow(meta)), 
    file=text.out,sep="\n",append = T)
```

## Parse information from IDs
```{r}
#re-wrote this parsing function with help of chatgpt to utilize purrr instead of for loops over lists, and overall more efficient/less redundant

#helper functions
safe_first<-function(x,default=""){if(length(x)==0||all(is.na(x)))default else x[1]}
safe_last<-function(x,default=""){if(length(x)==0||all(is.na(x)))default else x[length(x)]}
empty_if_bad<-function(x){if(length(x)==0||all(is.na(x)))"" else x[1]}

#location lookup list
unq_loc<-meta[,c("country","geo_location_sml")]%>%unlist(use.names=FALSE)
unq_loc<-unq_loc[!is.na(unq_loc)&unq_loc!=""]
us.states<-usa::state.name
china<-read.csv(china.cit.in)
china.region<-unique(china$admin_name)
cit<-maps::world.cities
cities<-cit$name
unq_loc<-unique(c(unq_loc,us.states,china.region,cities))
unq_loc<-unq_loc[unq_loc!="Turkey"]

#constants
year_range<-1905:2025
all.years<-paste(as.character(year_range),collapse="|")
all.segments<-paste(paste0("^",segments,"$"),collapse="|")

#segment patterns
segment_patterns<-list(
  PB2="segment 1|PB2|pb2|polymerase basic protein 2|polymerase basic 2|polymerase basic subunit 2",
  PB1="segment 2|PB1|pb1|polymerase basic protein 1|polymerase basic 1|polymerase basic subunit 1",
  PA ="segment 3|\\(PA\\)| PA |polymerase acid|polymerase acidic",
  HA ="segment 4|\\(HA\\)| HA |\\(ha\\)| ha |hemagglutinin|haemagglutinin|hemmaglutinin|Hemagglutinin",
  NP ="segment 5|NP|np|nucleocapsid|nucleoprotein|Nucleocapsid|Nucleoprotein",
  `NA` ="segment 6|\\(NA\\)| NA |\\(na\\)| na |neuraminidase|Neuraminidase",
  M  ="segment 7|\\(M\\)| M |\\(MA\\)| MA |matrix|Matrix|M1|M2",
  NS ="segment 8|NS|ns|nonstructural protein|non-structural protein"
)

too.many<-c()
why.strain<-c()

#parser function
parse_genbank_title<-function(t,unq_loc,all.years,all.segments,segment_patterns){
  t_split<-str_split(t,"\\/")[[1]]
  n_parts<-length(t_split)

  #strain
  strain_split<-str_split(t,
    " segment| serotype| viral| polymerase| hemagglutinin| neuraminidase| nonstructural| non-structural| nucleoprotein| nucleocapsid| matrix| membrane| nuclear| - gene| -- gene| - HA gene| - NA gene| - PB2 gene| - PB1 gene| - PA gene| - M gene| - NP gene| - NS gene | gene"
  )[[1]]
  my_strain<-if(length(strain_split)>1)strain_split[1] else {why.strain<<-c(why.strain,t);""}

  #host
  my_host<-safe_first(t_split[2])
  my_host<-str_to_sentence(my_host)
  my_host<-str_replace_all(my_host,"R\\(","")
  my_host<-empty_if_bad(my_host)
  if(str_detect(my_host,"Reassortant")&&n_parts>=3){
    my_host<-safe_last(str_split(t_split[3],"\\(")[[1]])
  }
  if(str_detect(my_host,"Hong Kong|Hong kong")&str_detect(t,"MDCK|Embryo"))my_host<-"Embryonated chicken egg"
  if(str_detect(my_host,"Influenza a virus|Influenza A virus|Puerto Rico"))my_host<-""

  #location
  my_location<-if(n_parts>=3)t_split[n_parts-2] else ""
  if(my_host%in%unq_loc){my_location<-my_host;my_host<-""}
  if(my_location%in%c("chicken","duck","pigeon","Mallard","little cuckoo-dove")&n_parts>=2){
    my_location<-t_split[n_parts-1]
  }
  if(str_detect(my_location," X | x "))my_location<-safe_first(str_split(my_location," X | x ")[[1]])
  if(str_detect(my_location,paste(as.character(1950:2025),collapse="|"))&n_parts>=4){
    my_location<-safe_last(str_split(t_split[n_parts-4],"\\(")[[1]])
  }
  if(str_detect(my_location,paste0("-",0:9,collapse="|"))){
    my_location<-safe_first(str_split(my_location,paste0("-",0:9,collapse="|"))[[1]])
  }
  if(my_location=="7732")my_location<-"Ontario"
  my_location<-empty_if_bad(my_location)

  #date
  t_paren<-t_split%>%str_split("\\(|\\)")%>%unlist()%>%trimws()
  t_paren<-t_paren[t_paren!=""]
  my_date<-str_subset(t_paren,all.years)
  my_date<-str_replace_all(my_date," X A| Original| OR_IR","")
  my_date<-str_split(my_date," ")%>%unlist()
  my_date<-my_date[my_date%in%as.character(year_range)]
  if(length(my_date)>1)my_date<-my_date[which.max(as.numeric(my_date))]
  my_date<-empty_if_bad(my_date)

  #subtype
  my_genotemp<-str_split(str_subset(t_paren,"H5N")," |-_|_")%>%unlist()
  my_subtype<-str_subset(my_genotemp,"H5N")
  my_subtype<-str_replace_all(my_subtype,"5H|3H|2H","H")
  my_subtype<-empty_if_bad(my_subtype)

  #segment
  last_chunk<-safe_last(t_split)
  t_seg_parts<-str_split(last_chunk,"\\(|\\)| ")%>%unlist()%>%trimws()
  my_geneseg<-str_subset(t_seg_parts,all.segments)
  if(length(my_geneseg)==0){
    for(seg in names(segment_patterns)){
      if(str_detect(last_chunk,segment_patterns[[seg]])){my_geneseg<-seg;break}
    }
  }
  my_geneseg<-empty_if_bad(my_geneseg)
  if(length(my_geneseg)>1){
    too.many<<-c(too.many,t)
    my_geneseg<-my_geneseg[1]
  }

  list(
    strain_parse=my_strain,
    host_parse=my_host,
    location_parse=my_location,
    date_parse=my_date,
    subtype_parse=my_subtype,
    geneseg_parse=my_geneseg
  )
}

#apply row parser
parsed_list<-purrr::map(meta$genbank_title,
  ~parse_genbank_title(.x,unq_loc,all.years,all.segments,segment_patterns)
)

parsed_df<-purrr::map_dfr(parsed_list,as.data.frame)
meta<-dplyr::bind_cols(meta,parsed_df)

#final host cleanup
meta$host_parse<-meta$host_parse%>%trimws()%>%
  str_replace_all("_"," ")%>%
  str_to_sentence()%>%
  str_replace_all("286cad|Puerto rico|Antarctica|Reverse genetic|Hong kong","")

#keep only true subtypes H[0-9]+N[0-9]+
meta$subtype_parse<-str_extract(meta$subtype_parse,"H[0-9]+N[0-9]+")
meta$subtype_parse[is.na(meta$subtype_parse)]<-""
# table(meta$subtype_parse)
meta$subtype<-str_replace_all(meta$subtype, c("H5N\\?"="H5Nx",
                                              "H5N2\\?"="H5Nx"))
```

## fill missing meta with parsed values and clean dates
```{r}
#change NA to "" where needed
if(any(is.na(meta$segment)))meta$segment[is.na(meta$segment)]<-""
if(any(is.na(meta$collection_date)))meta$collection_date[is.na(meta$collection_date)]<-""
if(any(is.na(meta$host)))meta$host[is.na(meta$host)]<-""
if(any(is.na(meta$geo_location)))meta$geo_location[is.na(meta$geo_location)]<-""
if(any(is.na(meta$subtype)))meta$subtype[is.na(meta$subtype)]<-""

#how bad to start (optional diagnostics)
length(which(meta$collection_date==""))  #dates missing 0
length(which(meta$segment==""))          #segments missing 429
length(which(meta$host==""))             #hosts missing 7828
length(which(meta$geo_location==""))     #locations missing 34
length(which(meta$subtype==""))          #subtypes missing 0

#create dup col for original host (usually latin names)
meta$host_latin<-meta$host

#by default, take the common name parsed from the strain
meta$host<-meta$host_parse

#vectorised data filling instead of row loop
meta$collection_date<-ifelse(meta$collection_date=="",meta$date_parse,meta$collection_date)
meta$segment<-ifelse(meta$segment=="",meta$geneseg_parse,meta$segment)
meta$host<-ifelse(meta$host=="",meta$host_latin,meta$host) #take latin if common/parsed not available
meta$geo_location<-ifelse(meta$geo_location=="",meta$location_parse,meta$geo_location)
meta$subtype<-ifelse(meta$subtype=="",meta$subtype_parse,meta$subtype)

#still missing dates?
no.date<-which(meta$collection_date=="")
length(no.date)  #for reference 0

#build patterns for abbreviated + full years
abb.yr<-c(
  as.character(50:99),              #1950-1999 (two-digit)
  paste0("0",0:9),                  #00-09 -> 2000-2009
  paste0("1",0:9),                  #10-19 -> 2010-2019
  as.character(1905:2025)           #full years
)
abb.years.s<-paste0("^(",paste(abb.yr,collapse="|"),")$")  #exact matches only

#helper to extract and normalize a year from a title string
extract_year_from_title<-function(tt){
  s<-str_split(tt,"\\/|\\(| |_|-")[[1]]
  my.yr<-str_subset(s,abb.years.s)
  if(length(my.yr)==0)return("")
  my.yr<-my.yr[length(my.yr)]  #if multiple, take later mentioned

  if(my.yr%in%paste0("0",0:9))return(paste0("20",my.yr))   #2000-2009
  if(my.yr%in%paste0("1",0:9))return(paste0("20",my.yr))   #2010-2019
  if(my.yr%in%as.character(50:99))return(paste0("19",my.yr)) #1950-1999
  if(my.yr%in%as.character(1905:2025))return(my.yr)        #already full year
  ""
}

#apply to titles with missing dates (vectorised via vapply)
titles_nd<-meta$genbank_title[no.date]
year_fills<-vapply(titles_nd,extract_year_from_title,character(1))
has_year<-year_fills!=""
meta$collection_date[no.date[has_year]]<-year_fills[has_year]

#manual corrections / known issues
meta$collection_date<-str_replace_all(meta$collection_date,"1905-07-14","2022")
meta$collection_date[str_which(meta$genbank_title,"2018X Puerto Rico/8/1934")]<-"2018"

#remaining no-date accession IDs (if any)
rem.date<-meta$accession[meta$collection_date==""]
length(rem.date) #0 

#disagreements?
look<-meta [which(meta$subtype_parse!=meta$subtype), c('subtype_parse', 'subtype')]
look %>% filter(subtype_parse!='') ##H5N2 that previously had ? (set as x)
```

## which hosts still have latin?
```{r latin to comm, message=F}
#find latin-looking host strings
latinx_pat<-"us$|is$|is |ara$|ae$|ea$|ia$|um$|Anser|es$|yla$|ped$|vison$|iba$|aca$|ata$|tta$|ubo$|alis$|allus|vus|stela|gata|xii|xa|ax|buteo|Larus"
latinx<-unique(str_subset(meta$host,latinx_pat))
latinx<-latinx[-str_which(latinx,
  "Alpaca|Mallard|-necked ibis|-eared|Multispecies|Munia|munia|Rhea|rhea|Ibis|ibis|hoabara"
)]

latinx1<-unique(unlist(str_split(latinx," ")))
latin.all<-unique(c(latinx,latinx1))

latin.still<-which(meta$host%in%latin.all)
length(latin.still)

latin.look.df<-data.frame(latin=unique(meta$host[latin.still]),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

latin.look.in<-"lookups/latin-common.csv"

if(file.exists(latin.look.in)){
  latin.look.df2<-read.csv(latin.look.in,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  latin.look.df2<-latin.look.df2[,-1]
  latin.look.df<-latin.look.df%>%left_join(latin.look.df2,by="latin")
}else{
  latin.look.df$common<-NA_character_
}

length(which(is.na(latin.look.df$common)))

#query taxize only for missing common names
missing_idx<-which(is.na(latin.look.df$common))
if(length(missing_idx)>0){
  for(i in missing_idx){
    out<-taxize::sci2comm(latin.look.df$latin[i])%>%unlist()
    if(length(out)>0)latin.look.df$common[i]<-str_to_sentence(out[1])
  }
}

#manual fills for remaining NA
na.comm<-which(is.na(latin.look.df$common))
if(length(na.comm)>0){
```

## write the common and latin name lookup
```{r}
#all common and latin names lookup
if(file.exists(unqhost.in)){unqhost<-read.csv(unqhost.in)}

#make a table of all unique species, if available, latin name
if(!file.exists(unqhost.in)){
  unqhost<-data.frame(common=unique(meta$host))
  unqhost<-unqhost %>% left_join(latin.look.df,by="common")
  nrow(unqhost) #481
  for(i in 1:nrow(unqhost)){
    if(is.na(unqhost$latin[i])){
      out<-taxize::comm2sci(unqhost$common[i]) %>% unlist()
      if(length(out)>0){unqhost$latin[i]<-str_to_sentence(out)}
    }
  }
  #export and fill-in with manual lookups later (07_host)
  write.csv(unqhost,unqhost.in)  }
```

## Clean up country and location
```{r}
#safety: no NA in key fields
meta$country[is.na(meta$country)]<-""
meta$geo_location[is.na(meta$geo_location)]<-""

#where is country missing where we have other location info?
nocount<-which(meta$country=="")
length(nocount)  #for reference

#fix some specific geos first
meta$geo_location[str_which(meta$genbank_title,"NIAH6-3-0019")]<-"Kamphaengphet"
meta$geo_location<-str_replace_all(meta$geo_location,
  c("HongKong"="Hong Kong",
    "Singapore-Q"="Singapore",
    "Pensylvania"="Pennsylvania",
    "zz"="",
    "unknown"="",
    "64650"="Denmark"))

#fill country from geo_location where missing
nocount<-which(meta$country=="")
if(length(nocount)>0){
  mygeo<-meta$geo_location[nocount]

  #USA: states or abbreviations
  idx_us<-nocount[mygeo%in%c(us.states,states$abb)]
  if(length(idx_us)>0)meta$country[idx_us]<-"USA"

  #China: regions or cities from china table
  idx_cn<-nocount[mygeo%in%c(china.region,unique(china$city))]
  if(length(idx_cn)>0)meta$country[idx_cn]<-"China"

  #other: match to world.cities by exact name (title-cased)
  idx_rest<-nocount[meta$country[nocount]=="" & mygeo!=""]
  if(length(idx_rest)>0){
    geo_rest<-meta$geo_location[idx_rest]
    nm_rest<-str_to_title(geo_rest)
    m_city<-match(nm_rest,cit$name)
    has_city<-which(!is.na(m_city))
    if(length(has_city)>0){
      meta$country[idx_rest[has_city]]<-cit$country.etc[m_city[has_city]]
    }
  }
}

#manual lookup table of remaining no country for specific geos
nocount<-which(meta$country=="")
if(length(nocount)>0){
  meta$country[nocount]<-str_replace_all(meta$geo_location[nocount],
    c("Denmark"="Denmark",
      "Hokkaido"="Japan",
      "Miyagi"="Japan",
      "Scotland"="Scotland",
      "Foehr"="Germany",
      "Vietnam"="Vietnam",
      "Thailand"="Thailand",
      "Thailand-Suphanburi"="Thailand",
      "Kamphaenphet"="Thailand",
      "Kamphaengphet"="Thailand",
      "Uthaithani"="Thailand",
      "Nakornsawan"="Thailand",
      "Nakhonsawan"="Thailand",
      "Nakhonphanom"="Thailand",
      "Suphanburi"="Thailand",
      "Nongkhai"="Thailand",
      "Sheyang"="China",
      "SanJiang"="China",
      "jiangsu"="China",
      "yunnan"="China",
      "Hong Kong"="Hong Kong",
      "Huadong"="China",
      "Syvash"="Ukraine",
      "Krasnoozerskoe"="Russia",
      "Suzdalka"="Russia",
      "Prymorsky"="Russia",
      "Hatay"="Turkey")
  )
}

nocount<-which(meta$country=="")
all(which(meta$country=="")==which(meta$geo_location==""))
length(nocount)  #remaining with no country & no geo

#countries that are actually states / cities / regions
meta$country[meta$country%in%c(us.states,us.cities$country.etc,"Penn")]<-"USA"
meta$country[meta$country%in%china.region]<-"China"

#use world.cities where country is actually a city name
cit2<-cit%>%filter(!name%in%cit$country.etc)
idx_city<-which(meta$country%in%cit2$name)
if(length(idx_city)>0){
  meta$country[idx_city]<-cit2$country.etc[match(meta$country[idx_city],cit2$name)]
}

#some specific renames
meta$country<-str_replace_all(meta$country,
  c("Gaza"="Palestine",
    "Jalisco"="Mexico")
)

#check turkey country vs species
turk<-which(meta$country=="Turkey")

#where country is Turkey but strain/organism name suggests elsewhere
turkey.locations<-paste(
  c(states$abb,
    states$name,
    "Suzdalka",
    "Israel",
    "Arabia",
    "Saudi Arabia",
    "SaudiArabia",
    "California",
    "^CA$",
    "Wisconsin",
    "Minnesota",
    "North_Dakota",
    "Ontario",
    "BC",
    "Ireland"), collapse="|")

not.turk<-str_which(meta$organism_name[turk],turkey.locations)
meta.notturk<-turk[not.turk]

if(length(meta.notturk)>0){
  for(i in meta.notturk){
    parts<-unlist(str_split(meta$organism_name[i],"/"))
    loc<-str_subset(parts,turkey.locations)
    if(length(loc)==0)next
    loc<-loc[1]
    meta$location_parse[i]<-loc
    meta$geo_location[i]<-loc
    if(loc%in%c(us.states,"CA"))meta$country[i]<-"USA"
    if(loc%in%c("Ontario","BC"))meta$country[i]<-"Canada"
    if(loc%in%c("Arabia","Saudi Arabia","SaudiArabia"))meta$country[i]<-"Saudi Arabia"
    if(loc%in%"Suzdalka")meta$country[i]<-"Russia"
    if(loc%in%"Israel")meta$country[i]<-"Israel"
    if(loc%in%"Ireland")meta$country[i]<-"Ireland"
  }
}

#lookup continent and region
dfc<-data.frame(country=unique(meta$country),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
dfc$continent<-countrycode(dfc$country,origin="country.name",destination="continent")
dfc$region<-countrycode(dfc$country,origin="country.name",destination="region23")

#add missing / special cases
dfc[dfc$country%in%c("Antarctica","South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands"),
    c("region","continent")]<-"Antarctica"
dfc$region[dfc$country=="Scotland"]<-"Northern Europe"
dfc$continent[dfc$country=="Scotland"]<-"Europe"
dfc$region<-str_replace(dfc$region,"Australia and New Zealand","Oceania")
dfc$region<-str_replace(dfc$region,"Northern America","North America")

table(dfc$continent)%>%sort()
table(dfc$region)%>%sort()

any(is.na(dfc$region))  #should be FALSE

write.csv(dfc,paste0(lookup.fold,"country_continent.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

#connect back to meta (multimatch expected)
meta<-meta%>%left_join(dfc,by="country")
```

## Identify duplicate segments with same concatenated sample and samples with no HA
```{r}
#per-sample counts (for QC)
samp<-meta%>%dplyr::group_by(sample)%>%count()
samp$sample[samp$n>8]%>%head()

#accessions for removal
rem.dup.segment<-c()
rem.incompleteseg<-c()
type.temp<-c()

# samples with no HA: remove all segments for those samples
seg.by.sample<-meta%>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_seg=dplyr::n_distinct(segment[segment!=""]),
    .groups="drop")

incomplete.samples<-seg.by.sample$sample[seg.by.sample$n_seg<8]
rem.incompleteseg<-meta$accession[which(meta$sample%in%incomplete.samples)]
rem.incompleteseg<-unique(rem.incompleteseg)

# duplicate segments within sample: pick best, drop others 
meta$row_id<-seq_len(nrow(meta))

#subset of rows that are duplicated within (sample,segment)
dup_info<-meta%>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample,segment)%>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n()>1)%>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

#split by sample+segment groups
if(nrow(dup_info)>0){
  dup_list<-split(dup_info,interaction(dup_info$sample,dup_info$segment,drop=TRUE))

  rem_list<-lapply(dup_list,function(df){
    #df has duplicated rows for one sample+segment
    idx_all<-df$row_id
    com<-df$nuc_completeness

    #1) complete vs partial: if any "complete", drop all non-"complete"
    if(any(com=="complete",na.rm=TRUE)){
      keep_pool<-which(com=="complete")
      rem_partial<-setdiff(seq_along(idx_all),keep_pool)
      rem_rows<-idx_all[rem_partial]
      reason<-rep("partial",length(rem_rows))
    }else{
      keep_pool<-seq_along(idx_all)
      rem_rows<-integer(0)
      reason<-character(0)
    }

    #rows still competing to keep
    pool_idx<-idx_all[keep_pool]

    #2) release date: keep newest, older→"older" (only if there is variation)
    if(length(pool_idx)>1){
      days<-df$release_date[keep_pool]
      if(sum(!is.na(days))>1&&length(unique(days[!is.na(days)]))>1){
        max_day<-max(days,na.rm=TRUE)
        keep_day<-which(days==max_day)[1]
        keep_row<-pool_idx[keep_day]
        rem_older<-setdiff(pool_idx,keep_row)
        rem_rows<-c(rem_rows,rem_older)
        reason<-c(reason,rep("older",length(rem_older)))
        pool_idx<-keep_row
      }
    }

    #3) sequence length: keep longest, shorter→"shorter"
    if(length(pool_idx)>1){
      lens<-df$length[keep_pool][match(pool_idx,idx_all[keep_pool])]
      if(length(unique(lens[!is.na(lens)]))>1){
        max_len<-max(lens,na.rm=TRUE)
        keep_len<-which(lens==max_len)[1]
        keep_row<-pool_idx[keep_len]
        rem_short<-setdiff(pool_idx,keep_row)
        rem_rows<-c(rem_rows,rem_short)
        reason<-c(reason,rep("shorter",length(rem_short)))
        pool_idx<-keep_row
      }
    }

    #4) if still >1 (identical), keep first row_id, others→"samesies"
    if(length(pool_idx)>1){
      keep_row<-pool_idx[1]
      rem_same<-setdiff(pool_idx,keep_row)
      rem_rows<-c(rem_rows,rem_same)
      reason<-c(reason,rep("samesies",length(rem_same)))
      pool_idx<-keep_row
    }

    if(length(rem_rows)==0)return(NULL)
    data.frame(row_id=rem_rows,reason=reason,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  })

  rem_df<-do.call(rbind,rem_list[!sapply(rem_list,is.null)])

  if(!is.null(rem_df)&&nrow(rem_df)>0){
    rem.dup.segment<-unique(meta$accession[match(rem_df$row_id,meta$row_id)])
    type.temp<-rem_df$reason[match(meta$accession[match(rem_df$row_id,meta$row_id)],rem.dup.segment)]
  }
}

#QC: numbers and reasons
rem.dup.segment<-unique(rem.dup.segment)
length(rem.dup.segment) #5651

if(length(type.temp)>0){
  table(type.temp)/length(type.temp)*100%>%sort()
}

rem.incompleteseg<-unique(rem.incompleteseg)
length(rem.incompleteseg) #12808
length(unique(c(rem.incompleteseg,rem.dup.segment)))  #total removed for both reasons
```

# Output meta and sequences by segment
## Separate into elements of lists 
```{r}
# nrow(meta.f)
# length(nuc)
#prime empty lists, each element will be a segments' meta/align
meta.segs<-nuc.segs <- replicate(n=length(segments),vector())
text.temp<-NA
for(i in 1:length(segments)){
  myseg<-segments[i]
  mymet<-which(meta.f$segment==myseg) 
  meta.segs[[i]]<-meta.f[mymet, ]
  
  #order of nuc elements matching mymeta accession
  mynuc<-match(meta.f$accession[mymet], nuc.names$accession)
  nuc.segs[[i]]<-nuc[mynuc]
  
  #text output of n seq by segment
  text.temp<-paste0(text.temp, 
                    "\nN sequences ", segments[i],": ", nrow(meta.segs[[i]])) 
  }
cat(text.temp, file=text.out,sep="\n",append = T)
```

## Read in protein sequences, coding regions
```{r}
#Read in proteins and coding regions

cds<-readDNAStringSet(cds.in)

length(prot) #254694
length(prot)==length(cds) #one to one by what variable? mix of assembly, biosample
range(width(prot))
range(width(cds))
```

## parse protein names
```{r}
#names df to parse
prot.names<-data.frame(seq_name=names(prot))

## first parse concat acc/genbank/isolate/biosample/sra/assembly
prot.names<-prot.names %>%  separate(seq_name, sep = "\\|", 
                                     into=c("prot_accession","genbank_title",
                                            "isolate","biosample",
                                            "sra_accession","assembly"), 
                                     remove = F)
prot.names$prot_accession<-trimws(prot.names$prot_accession)

prot.names<-prot.names %>%  
  separate(genbank_title, sep = " \\[|\\]", 
           into=c("protein","strain","xxx"), remove = F)
length(unique(prot.names$protein)) #130 unq proteins...
```

## parse coding region names 
```{r}
cds.names<-data.frame(seq_name=names(cds))

#these are named differently, and I think can be used to join the nucleotide and protein accessions...
cds.names<-cds.names %>%  separate(seq_name, sep = "\\|", 
                                     into=c("accession", #nuc accession + pos
                                            "genbank_title",
                                            "prot_accession",
                                         "biosample","sra_accession",
                                         "assembly", "isolate"), #isolate??
                                     remove = F)
cds.names$accession<-trimws(cds.names$accession)

cds.names<-cds.names %>%  
  separate(genbank_title, sep = " \\[|\\]", 
           into=c("codingregion","strain","xxx"), remove = F)
length(unique(cds.names$codingregion)) #130 unq codingregions...

## CDS nuc_accessions extraction
#remove join text and start new clean column
cds.names$accession_clean<-cds.names$accession %>%
  str_replace_all("join\\(","")%>%
  str_replace_all("\\)","")%>%
  trimws()

#nuc accession extract
cds.names$nuc_accession<-str_extract(cds.names$accession_clean,"^[^:]+")  

#coords: drop all ACC: prefixes, keep ranges (including < and >)
cds.names$nuc_coords<-cds.names$accession_clean%>%
  str_replace_all("[A-Za-z0-9_.]+:","")%>%
  trimws()

acc_multi<-str_extract_all(cds.names$accession_clean,"[A-Za-z0-9_.]+(?=:)")

bad_multi<-which(sapply(acc_multi,function(x)length(unique(x))>1))
length(bad_multi)  #should be 0 ideally

cds.names$nuc_coords<-str_replace_all(cds.names$nuc_coords,c("\\.\\."="-",
                                                             "\\<"="",
                                                             "\\>"=""))
```

## Join cds to prot
```{r}
all(cds.names$genbank_title %in% prot.names$genbank_title) #wow, that's nice
all(cds.names$prot_accession %in% prot.names$prot_accession) #nice! 
length(unique(prot.names$prot_accession))==nrow(prot.names) #and they're unique

#Prep data to join prot.names and cds.names
colnames(cds.names)<-colnames(cds.names) %>%
  str_replace_all(c("^accession$"="cds_accession",
                    "^seq_name$"="cds_seq_name"))
#JOIN
prot.cds.names<-left_join(prot.names,
                          cds.names[,c("prot_accession","cds_seq_name",
                                       "nuc_accession","nuc_coords")],
                          by="prot_accession")

#how matchy to nuc.names
length(which(nuc.names$accession %in% prot.cds.names$nuc_accession))
nrow(nuc.names) #nearly all have match
# nuc.names[which(!nuc.names$accession %in% cds.names$nuc_accession),]
```

## harmonize protein naming
```{r}
#lowercase protein names
prot.cds.names$protein[is.na(prot.cds.names$protein)]<-""

length(unique(prot.cds.names$protein))

#remove generic words and junk

  ",| protein|protein|protien| partial|partial|putative |subunit |subunit| subtype| ion channel|rna | virus|virus|truncated | chain|subtype h5| h5| esterase| proptein|\\(|\\)|endogenous |mag\\: ",    "")

  "neuraminidase|nueraminidase|neuramindase|neuraminadase|^na"="NA",
  "polymerase |polymerase| polymerase|plymerase"="P",
  "acidic|pa|^pa$"="A",
  "basic |basic|pb|b$"="B",
  "pb1 f1"="PB1-F1",
  " F|-f"="-F",
  "membrane m|membrane; |membrane|matrix m|matrix|m$|mp|^m"="M",
  "nucleoprotein|nucleocapsid|nucelocpasid|nucelocapsid|nucleo|np"="NP",
  "nuclear export|nuclear|nep"="NEP",
  "nonstructural ns|nonstructural|nonstructual|nonstractual|ns"="NS",
  "nsns"="NS",
  "Mm|M m|Matrix m"="M",
  "NA na"="NA",
  "HA ha"="HA",
  "AP|Pa|^A$|P A|^P$"="PA",
  "BP2|B2P|Pb2|B2$|^P2"="PB2",
  "BP1|B1P|Pb1|^B1|^P1"="PB1",
  "A-x"="PA-X",
  "NS1 NS"="NS1",
  "NP NP"="NP",
  "F2P|f2"="F2",
  " F2"="-F2",
  "^B2$"="PB2",
  "PPB2"="PB2",
  "nep\\/ns2|NS2\\/NEP|NEP\\/NS2|NS2|ns2|NEP1|NEP2"="NEP")

prot.cds.names$protein<-str_replace_all(prot.cds.names$protein,prot_map)%>%trimws()
length(unique(prot.cds.names$protein))
table(prot.cds.names$protein)%>%sort()

#manual fixes
# NS → NS1 (based on manual checks), should add something here
prot.cds.names$protein[prot.cds.names$protein=="NS"]<-"NS1"

# PB that are actually PA or PB1 (accession-specific)

                     str_detect(prot.cds.names$prot_accession,"ABI33")]<-"PB1"

#remove special chars in strain

#segment lookup table
protnm.seg<-read.csv(prot.segment.look,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

colnames(protnm.seg)[1]<-"protein"
```

## match to nucleotide samples by nuc accesssion
```{r}
#for coding region, we have nuc_accession (almost all)
#else assembly/sra/isolate to try to match proteins and connect via the sample (connects segment sequence nuc_accessions)

#make NA instead of "". note to self to remove capitalization inconsist
for(col in c("nuc_accession","biosample","prot_accession",
             "assembly","isolate","sra_accession","strain")){
  prot.cds.names[[col]][prot.cds.names[[col]]==""]<-NA
}

## do all sequences have meta (nuc) in original dataset? (diagnostics)
length(which(prot.cds.names$nuc_accession %in% meta.f$accession)) #228696
nrow(meta.f) #154496
m<-which(meta.f$accession %in% prot.cds.names$nuc_accession ) 
l.m<-length(m); l.m #154437
nrow(meta.f) - l.m #59 nucname sequences without a cds match
#wow, almost all nucs have at least one coding region match (multiples for M1,M2...)

#match iteratively to proteins through assembly 2, else assembly, else biosample.
match.acc<-which(!is.na(prot.cds.names$nuc_accession) &
                   prot.cds.names$nuc_accession%in%meta.f$accession)
match.ass<-which(!is.na(prot.cds.names$assembly) &
                   prot.cds.names$assembly%in%meta.f$assembly)
match.bio<-which(!is.na(prot.cds.names$biosample) &
                   prot.cds.names$biosample%in%meta.f$biosample)
length(match.acc) # 228696
length(match.ass) #215152
length(match.bio) #73996

#assign protein and coding sequences (df) a 'sample' from meta.f using priority:
# 1) nuc_accession, 2) assembly, 3) biosample, 4) strain_parse, 5) isolate (changed v2)
prot.cds.names$sample<-NA_character_
prot.cds.names$matched<-NA_character_

#1. nuc_accession (just accession in nuc_names)
acc.map<-meta.f%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(accession))%>%
  dplyr::select(accession,sample)%>%
  dplyr::distinct()

idx.acc<-match(prot.cds.names$nuc_accession, acc.map$accession)
hit.acc<-which(!is.na(idx.acc) & is.na(prot.cds.names$sample))
if(length(hit.acc)>0){
  prot.cds.names$sample[hit.acc]<-acc.map$sample[idx.acc[hit.acc]]
  prot.cds.names$matched[hit.acc]<-"nuc_accession"}

#2. assembly
ass.map<-meta.f%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(assembly))%>%
  dplyr::select(assembly,sample)%>%
  dplyr::distinct()

idx.ass<-match(prot.cds.names$assembly,ass.map$assembly)
hit.ass<-which(!is.na(idx.ass) & is.na(prot.cds.names$sample))
if(length(hit.ass)>0){
  prot.cds.names$sample[hit.ass]<-ass.map$sample[idx.ass[hit.ass]]
  prot.cds.names$matched[hit.ass]<-"assembly"}

#3. biosample
bio.map<-meta.f%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(biosample))%>%
  dplyr::select(biosample,sample)%>%
  dplyr::distinct()

idx.bio<-match(prot.cds.names$biosample,bio.map$biosample)
hit.bio<-which(!is.na(idx.bio) & is.na(prot.cds.names$sample))
if(length(hit.bio)>0){
  prot.cds.names$sample[hit.bio]<-bio.map$sample[idx.bio[hit.bio]]
  prot.cds.names$matched[hit.bio]<-"biosample"}

#4. Strain (using strain_parse in meta.f)
str.map<-meta.f%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(strain_parse))%>%
  dplyr::select(strain_parse,sample)%>%
  dplyr::distinct()

idx.str<-match(prot.cds.names$strain,str.map$strain_parse)
hit.str<-which(!is.na(idx.str) & is.na(prot.cds.names$sample))
if(length(hit.str)>0){
  prot.cds.names$sample[hit.str]<-str.map$sample[idx.str[hit.str]]
  prot.cds.names$matched[hit.str]<-"strain"}

#5. isolate
iso.map<-meta.f%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(isolate))%>%
  dplyr::select(isolate,sample)%>%
  dplyr::distinct()

idx.iso<-match(prot.cds.names$isolate, iso.map$isolate)
hit.iso<-which(!is.na(idx.iso) & is.na(prot.cds.names$sample))
if(length(hit.iso)>0){
  prot.cds.names$sample[hit.iso]<-iso.map$sample[idx.iso[hit.iso]]
  prot.cds.names$matched[hit.iso]<-"isolate"}

#how many still NA (how many filled in)?
nocdssamp<-which(is.na(prot.cds.names$sample))
nocdssamp<-unique(nocdssamp)
length(nocdssamp) # 18 828 #many/most of these may be connected to nuc samples that were filtered (passaged, vaccine, clone, incomplete, .. )
# prot.cds.names[nocdssamp, ]

#REMOVE protein/coding with no matching assembly, prot_accession, biosample, or strain
prot.cds.names<-prot.cds.names%>%dplyr::filter(!is.na(sample))
nrow(prot.cds.names) # 235866

#text out
cat(paste0("Protein and coding sequences rem due to no matching accession, assembly, biosample in cleaned nuc meta: ", length(nocdssamp)),
    file=text.out,sep="\n",append=TRUE)
```

## Identify duplicate proteins/coding with same sample
```{r}
samp.pr<-prot.cds.names%>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample)%>%
  count()

#find duplicated sample+protein combos
dup_prot<-prot.cds.names%>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample,protein)%>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n()>1)%>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

rem.dup.protein<-c()
type.temp<-c()

if(nrow(dup_prot)>0){
  #for each sample+protein, keep first, remove the rest
  dup_drop<-dup_prot%>%
    dplyr::group_by(sample,protein)%>%
    dplyr::slice(-1)%>%           #drop all but first
    dplyr::ungroup()

  rem.dup.protein<-unique(dup_drop$prot_accession)
  type.temp<-rep("samesies",length(rem.dup.protein))
}

length(rem.dup.protein)  #number of duplicate protein records to remove 7160

if(length(type.temp)>0){
  table(type.temp)/length(type.temp)*100%>%sort()}

#remove the duplicates to filtered df
prot.cds.names.f<-prot.cds.names%>%
  dplyr::filter(!prot_accession%in%rem.dup.protein)

nrow(prot.cds.names.f) #228706
length(unique(prot.cds.names.f$sample)) #19312
```

```{r}
prot.cds.names.f<- prot.cds.names.f %>% 
  unite(col = newname, #should call this protname in the future, and cdsname also
        prot_accession, nuc_accession, protein, sep = "|",remove = F)
head(prot.cds.names.f$newname)

prot.meta<-prot.segs<-replicate(n=length(prot.ord),vector())
text.temp<-NA
for(i in 1:length(prot.ord)){
  myprot<-prot.ord[i] # for each protein
  #what protein data matches this prot
  matchprot<-which(prot.cds.names.f$protein==myprot)
  #original seq_name is specific to protein seq
  matchprotacc<-match(prot.cds.names.f$seq_name[matchprot],names(prot))
  #subset the protein amino acid sequence set
  prot.segs[[i]]<-prot[matchprotacc] 
  prot.meta[[i]]<-prot.cds.names.f[matchprot,]
  #Rename protein sequences with accession_strain_protein
  names(prot.segs[[i]])<-prot.meta[[i]]$newname
  # all(names(prot.segs[[i]]) %in%   prot.meta[[i]]$seq_name)
  text.temp<-paste0(text.temp, 
                    "\nN sequences ", prot.ord[i],": ", length(prot.segs[[i]]))}

cat(text.temp, file=text.out,sep="\n",append = T)
```

## Repeat for coding region sequences
```{r}
cds.meta<-cds.segs<-replicate(n=length(prot.ord),vector())
cds.text.temp<-NA
for(i in 1:length(prot.ord)){
  myprot<-prot.ord[i] # for each cds
  #what cds data matches this cds
  matchprot<-which(prot.cds.names.f$protein==myprot)
  matchprotacc<-match(prot.cds.names.f$cds_seq_name[matchprot],names(cds))
  #subset the cds amino acid sequence set
  cds.segs[[i]]<-cds[matchprotacc]
  cds.meta[[i]]<-prot.cds.names.f[matchprot,]
  #Rename cds sequences with protaccession_nucaccession_protein
  names(cds.segs[[i]])<-cds.meta[[i]]$newname
  text.temp<-paste0(text.temp,
                    "\nN coding sequences ", prot.ord[i],": ", length(cds.segs[[i]]))}

cat(text.temp, file=text.out,sep="\n",append = T)
```

## Export unaligned proteins/coding regions and corresponding meta
```{r}
prot.ord2<-str_replace_all(prot.ord, " |\\/","")
prot.meta.out<-paste0(f.out,"ncbi_protein_meta_",prot.ord2,".csv")
prot.out<-paste0(f.out,"ncbi_protein_",prot.ord2,".fasta")

## Export data in list, purr version
purrr::walk2(prot.meta, prot.meta.out, ~write.csv(.x,.y,row.names=FALSE))
purrr::walk2(prot.segs, prot.out, ~writeXStringSet(.x,.y))

## Export unaligned codingregions and corresponding meta
prot.ord2<-str_replace_all(prot.ord, " |\\/","")
# cds.meta.out<-paste0(f.out,"ncbi_codingregion_meta_",prot.ord2,".csv") #same as prot.meta
cds.out<-paste0(f.out,"ncbi_codingregion_",prot.ord2,".fasta")

## Export data in list, purr version
# purrr::walk2(cds.meta, cds.meta.out, ~write.csv(.x,.y,row.names=FALSE))
purrr::walk2(cds.segs, cds.out, ~writeXStringSet(.x,.y))
```
